about: (6c F3 §10.1, §3.4) a coral pond and a coral fountain on a flat claim: a natural pond (13x11, 3 deep at its centre) with mixed coral inside it (4 patches, cover 0.4), and a fountain (basin 7) with brain coral in its basin's bed. Each coral part compiles into its body: the body op's decor set, the body's own cells (M25:clear 0 with no exception). (The 2x2 pit at the claim's north-west corner, in its margin, puts 6 courses of dirt under the plain in game, as KC's v61: over the flat base's own grass a natural pond's shell would stand on buried grass the realise never replaces)
